verdict.rationale: First-party marketing documents a free developer tier ('spin up a dev instance to kick the tires', up to 4 vCPU / 8 GB RAM) with no credit card required. The docs describe a self-serve path 'from signup to your first query in about five minutes': create a cluster, connect a client, load data, and query, with no sales call needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-card signup, and details on dev-tier limits such as storage caps, time limits, or whether instances expire.
